title: Water Proofing Treatment for terrace roof of Deep Bhavan office building, Chennai
summary: Two-cover percentage-rate e-tender for waterproofing treatment of the terrace roof of the Deep Bhavan office building, Chennai.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, 5/20 Jaffer Syrang Street, Chennai

scope.item: Water proofing treatment for terrace roof of Deep Bhavan office building

money.notes: Estimated cost including 18% GST. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled/nationalized bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai; validity stated as three months (table) and 90 days (clause 1.1) from technical bid opening. Tender fee and EMD exempted for valid MSME/NSIC registered firms.

period.completion: 03 (three) months from the date of handing over of site
period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies
Authorized applicators of waterproofing product, or civil contractors who execute the work through authorized applicators (undertaking required with technical bid)
Similar works in Govt/PSU in last seven years: three >= 40%, two >= 50% or one >= 80% of estimated cost; values updated at 7% simple interest; certificates from officer not below Executive Engineer
Similar works: waterproofing treatment to terrace of RCC buildings or any civil construction/repair works
CA-certified average annual turnover on construction works at least 40% of estimated cost in last 3 financial years ending 31 March 2024

Key technical personnel; unconditional tender undertaking (Annexure III); tender acceptance letter (Annexure II); non-blacklisting affidavit; relatives list; Make in India self-certification (Annexure VI)
notes: NIT Section I only; no BOQ or waterproofing specification. Download/submission 13.12.2024 (10:00) to 07.01.2025 (15:00); opening 08.01.2025 15:00.
